description: Which files historically change together with this one? Directional: "when I touch A, B changes 45% of the time" and the reverse, because the asymmetry is the signal. Flags coupled files with NO import edge — config, fixtures, generated code and string-keyed lookups the structural graph cannot see. Co-change is correlation, not causation; commits touching more than 50 files are excluded as refactors.

cursor.description: continuation token from a truncated response; repeat the same arguments with it

max_tokens.description: soft cap on response size in estimated tokens; truncated output says how to get the rest

path.description: file whose historical co-changes you want (workspace-relative)

name: change_coupling
title: Change coupling
